sloka: निषसाद च हस्तेन गृहीत्वा वालिनः सुतम् ।रमणीये वनोद्देशे महेन्द्रस्य गिरेस्तदा ।। 5.57.36 ।।।।
transliteration: niṣasāda ca hastena gṛhītvā vālinaḥ sutam ।ramaṇīye vanoddeśe mahendrasya girestadā ।। 5.57.36 ।।।।

translations.english: Then holding the hand of Vali's son he sat down at a beautiful location of the garden of mountain Mahendra.
